request.subject: new integration dev - couple of questions
request.body: Hi, I've just taken over our integration with you from a colleague who left. Two things I can't find written down on our side: (1) what's the ceiling on API calls for our tier before you start rejecting us, and how am I supposed to know how long to wait when that happens? We're about to backfill ~2 years of shipment metrics. (2) how do we prove the event callbacks hitting our endpoint actually came from you and aren't spoofed? Thanks!

rationale: Both concerns are documented. Brightpath is on the growth plan (10-org.json customer_brightpath) so 20-docs-api-rate-limits.md gives 300 req/min, burst 50, HTTP 429 with Retry-After/X-RateLimit-Remaining, and recommends /v2/metrics:batch for backfills; work_retry_after_header is done and attempt_corvid_429_bulk is a capability-scoped (cap_api_rate_limits:v4.2) verified-passed resolution for exactly a backfill. 20-docs-webhooks.md 'Signatures' covers HMAC-SHA256 X-Lumetric-Signature + X-Lumetric-Timestamp (5 min); request_brightpath_webhook_signature was resolved the same way. Nothing is broken and no quota increase is asked, so no work/escalation; work_rate_limit_burst concerns paginated reads (request_tamarind_api_pagination), not this backfill question. decision_brightpath_actions permits answer.
notes: Two-concern request; a good answer covers both and cites both docs.
